label: TP
reason: User input flows directly to response.writer() without proper HTML entity encoding. The split(" ")[0] truncation is ineffective against XSS payloads without leading spaces (e.g., <script>alert(1)</script>). Response header X-XSS-Protection set to 0 disables browser protections.

evidence.note: User parameter retrieved and written to response without HTML encoding; split truncation does not prevent script-based XSS
